vocab.sentence: The waitress needs to clean the tables.

vocab.sentence: The mailman stopped to drink some water.

vocab.sentence: My brother wants to be a police officer.

vocab.sentence: The secretary finished making the phone calls.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位秘書打完了電話。

vocab.sentence: The factory worker hopes to go home early.

vocab.sentence: The actress decided to learn English.

vocab.sentence: The reporter wants to ask a question.

vocab.sentence: The singer enjoys singing for children.

vocab.sentence: The writer plans to write a funny story.

vocab.sentence: Listening to music is fun for me.

vocab.sentence: My sister practices playing the guitar after school.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我姊姊放學後練習彈吉他。

vocab.sentence: Tom wants to buy a new drum.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Tom 想買一個新鼓。

vocab.sentence: I hope to teach English in the future.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我希望未來能教英文。

vocab.sentence: Making short videos is interesting for us.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 製作短影片對我們來說很有趣。

vocab.sentence: Remember to bring your camera tomorrow.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 記得明天要帶你的相機。

vocab.sentence: It is important to get enough sleep.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 獲得充足的睡眠很重要。

vocab.sentence: The popular singer loves singing for her fans.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位受歡迎的歌手喜歡為歌迷唱歌。

vocab.sentence: She has a gift for telling funny stories.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她有講好笑故事的天分。

vocab.sentence: Mom told me not to stay up late.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 媽媽告訴我不要熬夜。

vocab.sentence: We enjoy watching funny videos after dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們喜歡晚餐後看好笑的影片。

vocab.sentence: They plan to practice together this weekend.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們計畫這個週末一起練習。

vocab.sentence: The movie star hopes to visit Taiwan.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位電影明星希望來臺灣遊玩。

vocab.sentence: He left the room without saying goodbye.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他沒有說再見就離開房間了。

vocab.sentence: My dream is to become a teacher.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的夢想是成為老師。

vocab.sentence: The teenager decided to join the school team.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位青少年決定加入校隊。

vocab.sentence: Watching the basketball game is exciting.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 看這場籃球賽令人興奮。

vocab.sentence: The teacher told us not to fight.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 老師告訴我們不要打架。

vocab.sentence: We enjoy helping one another with our homework.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們喜歡在功課上互相幫忙。

vocab.sentence: He needs to save money for a camera.

vocab.sentence: The famous writer enjoys reading at night.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位有名的作家喜歡在晚上閱讀。

vocab.sentence: The players need to train every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些球員需要每天訓練。

vocab.sentence_chinese: 令人遺憾地，這位歌手決定不再唱歌。

vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想跟朋友們組隊。

vocab.sentence: We have to finish cleaning the classroom.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們必須打掃完教室。

vocab.sentence: The doctor asked me not to stay up.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 醫生要求我不要熬夜。

phrases.sentence: Gina is really good at playing the piano.
I enjoy sports, for example, swimming and running.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我喜歡運動，例如游泳和跑步。

phrases.sentence: Jason worked day and night to finish the project.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Jason 日以繼夜地工作來完成這個專案計畫。

phrases.sentence: They helped one another with their homework.
The singer wants to team up with a writer.

phrases.sentence: The student stayed up studying last night.

tips.label: 先看前面的動詞
tips.text: want、need、plan、decide、hope 後接 to V；enjoy、keep、practice、finish、mind 後接 V-ing。

tips.label: 叫某人做或不要做
tips.text: ask／tell／want＋人＋to V；否定用 not to V：Mom told me not to stay up.

tips.label: 介系詞後接 V-ing
tips.text: at、about、for、without 後接動名詞：be good at singing；without taking a break。

tips.label: 意思會改變
tips.text: remember／forget to V 是記得／忘了要做；接 V-ing 是記得／忘了做過。stop V-ing 停止原動作；stop to V 停下來做另一件事。

tips.label: 看清楚誰是主詞
tips.text: Making videos 是一件事，用 is；Swimming classes 的主詞是複數 classes，用 are。

tips.label: 用 it 把長主詞移到後面
tips.text: Playing the guitar is fun. → It is fun to play the guitar. 對某人來說可加 for＋人。

notes.title: 不定詞作動詞受詞
notes.description: to 後用原形動詞，不因主詞或時間而改變。第一個動詞依句子需要改變，第二個動詞仍用 to V。例如 planned to buy，不能寫 planned bought。
examples: I want to be a reporter.（我想當記者。）
The actress decided to learn English.（這位女演員決定學英文。）
We would like to make a video.（我們想製作一支影片。）

notes.title: 不定詞作受詞補語
notes.description: 先說對誰提出要求或教導，再說要做的事。人稱代名詞在這裡用受格，如 me、him、her、us、them。
examples: The writer asked me to read her story.（這位作家請我讀她的故事。）
Dad taught us to play the drums.（爸爸教我們打鼓。）
They want him to join the team.（他們想要他加入隊伍。）

notes.title: 不定詞的否定
notes.description: 否定後面的動作時，在 to 前加 not。planned not to go 表示計畫不去；did not plan to go 則是否定「有計畫」這件事，意思不同。
examples: The teacher told us not to fight.（老師告訴我們不要打架。）
They decided not to buy the camera.（他們決定不買那台相機。）
Mom asked me not to stay up.（媽媽叫我不要熬夜。）

notes.title: 動名詞作動詞受詞
notes.description: 這些動詞在本課用法中，後面接動名詞。不要因為第一個動詞是過去式，就把後面的動名詞也改成過去式。mind 常用於禮貌問句；quit 表示停止原本的習慣或活動。
examples: The singer practices singing every day.（這位歌手每天練習唱歌。）
We finished making the video.（我們完成影片製作了。）
Do you mind opening the window?（你介意打開窗戶嗎？）
He kept training after school.（他放學後持續訓練。）

notes.title: 介系詞後面的動名詞
notes.description: be good at／be bad at、think about、be happy about、be sorry for、thank 人 for、without、How about 等結構中的介系詞後面用 V-ing。without 表示沒有做某事。
examples: She is good at telling funny stories.（她擅長講好笑的故事。）
He left without saying goodbye.（他沒說再見就離開了。）
Thank you for helping me.（謝謝你幫助我。）
How about listening to music?（聽音樂如何？）

notes.title: 常見的 V-ing 補充用法
notes.rule: be busy／have fun／have trouble／be used to＋V-ing
notes.description: be busy 表示忙著做；have fun 表示做某事很開心；have trouble 表示做某事有困難。be used to 表示習慣於，此處的 to 是介系詞，所以接 V-ing；不同於表示過去習慣的 used to＋原形動詞。本課正式題以基本用法為主。
examples: The secretary is busy answering calls.（這位秘書正忙著接電話。）
We had fun making videos.（我們製作影片玩得很開心。）
I am used to getting up early.（我習慣早起。）

notes.title: 可接不定詞也可接動名詞
notes.description: 在本課的常見句型中，這些動詞後兩種形式都可用。出題時不能把兩種合理形式同時當作互斥選項。and 連接同一層次的動作時，練習使用平行形式。
examples: I like listening to music. / I like to listen to music.（我喜歡聽音樂。）
The star started to sing. / The star started singing.（這位明星開始唱歌。）
She likes writing stories and drawing pictures.（她喜歡寫故事和畫圖。）

notes.title: remember 與 forget 的意思差異
notes.rule: remember／forget＋to V：記得／忘記要做；＋V-ing：記得／忘記做過
notes.description: 判斷重點是事情發生了沒有。remember to V 是把該做的事記住；remember V-ing 是回想已做過的事。forget to V 表示漏做；forget V-ing 表示事情發生過，但後來不記得。
examples: Remember to bring your guitar tomorrow.（記得明天要帶吉他。）
I remember meeting the singer last year.（我記得去年見過那位歌手。）
I forgot to send the message.（我忘記傳那則訊息了。）
I forgot meeting him, but this photo shows us together.（我忘記曾見過他，但這張照片裡有我們兩人。）

notes.title: stop 的意思差異
notes.rule: stop＋V-ing：停止原動作；stop＋to V：停下來做另一件事
notes.description: 先找出原本在做什麼，再看後面的動作是被停止，還是新開始。例如原本跑步，現在改喝水，用 stopped to drink；原本一直說話，後來安靜下來，用 stopped talking。
examples: The actors stopped talking when the show began.（表演開始時，演員們停止交談。）
We were walking home and stopped to buy some water.（我們走路回家途中停下來買水。）

notes.title: 動名詞當主詞與主詞單複數
notes.description: 把整件事當主詞時，通常視為單數，例如 Making videos is fun，videos 是 Making 的受詞。Swimming classes are popular 的主詞中心則是複數名詞 classes。兩個活動用 and 連接，若明確分為兩件事，通常用複數；若視為一個整體，語意可能不同，需依上下文判斷。
examples: Writing funny stories is interesting.（寫好笑的故事很有趣。）
Swimming classes are popular here.（這裡的游泳課很受歡迎。）
Writing stories and taking photos are two different tasks.（寫故事和拍照是兩種不同的工作。）

notes.title: 虛主詞 it 與句型互換
notes.description: 真正要描述的事情放在 to V 片語中，句首用 it 佔主詞位置。it 搭配單數 be 動詞；疑問句把 be 移到 it 前面。動名詞主詞也可以改寫成這個句型。
examples: Playing the guitar is fun. → It is fun to play the guitar.（彈吉他很有趣。）
It is hard for me to learn this song.（學這首歌對我來說很難。）
Is it easy to use this camera?（這台相機容易使用嗎？）

notes.title: for 人與 of 人的補充
notes.description: difficult、easy、important 等描述事情對某人的難易或重要性，常用 for。kind、nice、wrong 等若是在評價某人做這件事的行為或特質，常用 of。這裡用例句說明，不在文法題中單獨考介系詞搭配。
examples: It is important for teenagers to sleep well.（睡好對青少年很重要。）
It is kind of you to help me.（你幫助我，真是好心。）

quiz.question: The teenager wants ___ a reporter when he grows up.
quiz.hint: wants 後面接不定詞 to V；a reporter 前需用 be，所以選 to be。

quiz.question: Our team enjoys ___ funny videos about school life.
quiz.hint: enjoys 後面接動名詞 V-ing；make 要去 e 加 ing，變成 making。

quiz.question: The sign says "No photos." The guard told us ___ photos here.
quiz.hint: No photos 表示禁止拍照；tell＋人＋not to V 表示告訴某人不要做某事。

quiz.question: Writing funny stories ___ an interesting job for this teenager.
quiz.hint: 主詞是 Writing funny stories 這整件事，視為單數；stories 是受詞，不能據此選 are。

quiz.question: It is easy for my grandfather ___ this small camera.
quiz.hint: 句型是 It is＋形容詞＋for 人＋to V；真正要說的事放在 to use this small camera。

quiz.question: The singer needs ___ a new guitar before the next show.
quiz.hint: needs 後接不定詞 to V，表示需要去買；第二個動詞 buy 不加 s 或 ing。

quiz.question: The actress practices ___ in front of the camera every day.
quiz.hint: practices 後接動名詞 speaking；every day 不會把這個補語變成 speaks。

quiz.question: The police officer asked the children ___ behind the line.
quiz.hint: ask＋人＋to V 表示要求某人做某事；asked the children 後接 to wait。

quiz.question: The writer walked into the room without ___ a word.
quiz.hint: without 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing；前面的 walked 是過去式，也不會讓這裡改用 said。

quiz.question: ___ is important for teenagers to get enough sleep.
quiz.hint: 後面的 to get enough sleep 才是真正描述的事情，句首用虛主詞 It，和 is 搭配。

quiz.question: The factory workers plan ___ a music club next month.
quiz.hint: plan 後接 to V；next month 提供未來計畫的情境，但選形式的關鍵是 plan。

quiz.question: We finished ___ the drums before the music class began.
quiz.hint: finish 後面接動名詞；move 去 e 加 ing，變成 moving。

quiz.question: The waitress is good at ___ customers feel welcome.
quiz.hint: at 是介系詞，後面要接動名詞 making；不能接原形或 to make。

quiz.question: The two children wanted to keep the gift a secret, so they decided ___ anyone about it.
quiz.hint: decide 後接不定詞；想保密表示決定不要告訴別人，否定式用 not to tell。

quiz.question: These guitar lessons ___ popular with teenagers in our town.
quiz.hint: 主詞是複數 These guitar lessons，需用 are；形容課程受歡迎不是用原形 be。

quiz.question: The reporter hopes ___ the famous actor after the show.
quiz.hint: hope 後接 to V，所以是 hopes to meet；不是希望動作進行中的 meeting。

quiz.question: The players kept ___ even after the sun went down.
quiz.hint: keep 後接 V-ing。kept 已表示過去，後面的補語仍是 training，不是 trained。

quiz.question: The secretary thanked me for ___ her find the missing papers.
quiz.hint: for 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 helping；thanked 的過去時間不改變此結構。

quiz.question: We were walking to the station. We were thirsty, so we stopped ___ some water and then kept walking.
quiz.hint: 原本的動作是走路，停下來是為了買水這個新動作，因此用 stopped to buy。

quiz.question: Tomorrow is the school show. Please remember ___ your guitar with you.
quiz.hint: Tomorrow 表示演出尚未發生，這是在提醒記得要帶吉他，用 remember to bring。

quiz.question: The message is still on my phone. I forgot ___ it to the secretary, so she never received it.
quiz.hint: 秘書沒有收到訊息，表示傳送這件事漏做了；forget to V 表示忘記要做。

quiz.question: A: Do you know this singer? B: Yes. I remember ___ her at our school last year.
quiz.hint: 回答 Yes 且提到 last year，是回想已經見過的人；remember V-ing 表示記得做過。

quiz.question: The actors were talking loudly. When the show began, they stopped ___ and became quiet.
quiz.hint: 原本正在說話，後來變安靜，表示停止原動作，使用 stopped talking；to talk 反而是停下來開始說話。

quiz.question: I completely forgot ___ this actor last year until Dad showed me our photo together.
quiz.hint: 照片顯示去年確實見過這位演員，只是後來忘了這段經驗，所以用 forgot meeting。

quiz.question: I would like ___ how to make an interesting video.
quiz.hint: would like 表示想要，後接 to V，所以是 would like to learn。

quiz.question: The young waiter learned ___ simple meals during the summer.
quiz.hint: learn 後接不定詞 to V；learned 已經表示過去，後面仍用 to cook。

quiz.question: The students are preparing ___ on stage for the first time.
quiz.hint: prepare 後接 to V，表示準備去做；are preparing 的進行式不會讓後面也接 singing。

quiz.question: My uncle loves ___ the drums with his friends after work.
quiz.hint: love 可接 V-ing 或 to V；本題四個選項中只有 playing 符合，沒有另一個可用的 to play。

quiz.question: We ran inside when it started ___ during the show.
quiz.hint: start 可接 to V 或 V-ing；本題只有 to rain 是可用的補語形式。

quiz.question: The reporter enjoys taking photos and ___ short stories for children.
quiz.hint: enjoy 後接 V-ing；and 前已有 taking，後面也用 writing，兩個動作形式平行。

quiz.question: Do you mind ___ the window? It is very hot in the room.
quiz.hint: mind 後接動名詞 opening；Do you mind V-ing? 是詢問對方是否介意做某事。

quiz.question: How about ___ up with the other team for the next game?
quiz.hint: How about 後用 V-ing；about 是介系詞，因此 team 變成 teaming。

quiz.question: The writer is busy ___ a new story for the school newspaper.
quiz.hint: be busy 後接 V-ing，表示忙著做某事；write 去 e 加 ing。

quiz.question: The teenagers had fun ___ music together in the park.
quiz.hint: have fun 後接 V-ing，表示做某事很開心；had 表示過去，後面仍用 playing。

quiz.question: The teacher taught the actor ___ a horse for the movie.
quiz.hint: teach＋人＋to V 表示教某人做某事；taught the actor 後接 to ride。

quiz.question: The famous writer invited us ___ her new house.
quiz.hint: invite＋人＋to V 表示邀請某人做某事；invited us 後要接 to visit。

quiz.question: We chose ___ at home because it was raining heavily.
quiz.hint: choose 的過去式是 chose，後接不定詞 to V；本句用 chose to stay。

quiz.question: Taking photos of the stars ___ difficult without a good camera.
quiz.hint: Taking photos of the stars 整體是一件事，視為單數，用 is；photos 和 stars 都不是主詞中心。

quiz.question: Writing stories and taking photos ___ two different tasks in our club.
quiz.hint: 句子明講 two different tasks，將兩個動名詞活動分開看待，主詞視為複數，用 are。

quiz.question: Is ___ easy for you to save money every month?
quiz.hint: 這是 Is it＋形容詞＋for 人＋to V 的疑問句；it 指向後面的存錢這件事。

quiz.question: ___ the drums at midnight is a bad idea.
quiz.hint: 空格到 midnight 整體作 is 的主詞，需將動作名詞化成 Playing the drums。

quiz.question: ___ is fun to train with the team, even on rainy days.
quiz.hint: to train with the team 才是真正描述的事，句首以虛主詞 It 搭配 is。

quiz.question: The two singers are thinking about ___ a new band together.
quiz.hint: think about 中 about 是介系詞，後接動名詞 starting。

quiz.question: The singer told me ___ the microphone closer to my mouth.
quiz.hint: tell＋人＋to V 表示告訴某人做某事；told me 後接 to hold。

quiz.question: The actress would love ___ the children at our school.
quiz.hint: would love 表示很想要，後接 to V；這裡是 would love to visit。

quiz.question: The little boy began ___ when he saw his favorite star.
quiz.hint: begin 可接 V-ing 或 to V；本題只有 smiling 是合用的形式。

quiz.question: My grandfather quit ___ because he wanted to be healthy.
quiz.hint: quit 表示停止某種習慣，後接動名詞 smoking，不接 to smoke。

quiz.question: The teenager had trouble ___ the heavy drum by himself.
quiz.hint: have trouble 後接 V-ing，表示做某事有困難；carry 加 ing 直接變 carrying。

quiz.question: We want him ___ our team because he is a great singer.
quiz.hint: want＋人＋to V 表示希望某人做某事；want him 後接 to join。

quiz.question: Learning ___ the guitar takes time and practice.
quiz.hint: learn 後接 to V；Learning 雖然在句首作主詞的一部分，後面仍保留 learn to play 的結構。

vocab.sentence: The waiter enjoys talking to people.

vocab.sentence: The mailman stopped to drink some water.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位郵差停下來喝了點水。

vocab.sentence: My brother wants to be a police officer.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我哥哥想當警察。

vocab.sentence: I hope to teach English in the future.

vocab.sentence: Making short videos is interesting for us.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 製作短影片對我們來說很有趣。

vocab.sentence: Remember to bring your camera tomorrow.

vocab.sentence: It is important to get enough sleep.

vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位受歡迎的歌手喜歡為歌迷唱歌。

vocab.sentence: She has a gift for telling funny stories.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她有講好笑故事的天分。

vocab.sentence: Mom told me not to stay up late.

vocab.sentence: We enjoy watching funny videos after dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們喜歡晚餐後看好笑的影片。

vocab.sentence: They plan to practice together this weekend.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們計畫這個週末一起練習。

vocab.sentence: The movie star hopes to visit Taiwan.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位電影明星希望來臺灣遊玩。

vocab.sentence: He left the room without saying goodbye.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他沒有說再見就離開房間了。

vocab.sentence: My dream is to become a teacher.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的夢想是成為老師。

vocab.sentence: The teenager decided to join the school team.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位青少年決定加入校隊。

vocab.sentence: Watching the basketball game is exciting.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 看這場籃球賽令人興奮。

vocab.sentence: The teacher told us not to fight.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 老師告訴我們不要打架。

vocab.sentence: We enjoy helping one another with our homework.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們喜歡在功課上互相幫忙。

vocab.sentence: He needs to save money for a camera.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他需要存錢買相機。

vocab.sentence: The famous writer enjoys reading at night.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位有名的作家喜歡在晚上閱讀。

vocab.sentence: The players need to train every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些球員需要每天訓練。

vocab.sentence: Sadly, the singer decided to stop singing.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 令人遺憾地，這位歌手決定不再唱歌。

vocab.sentence: I want to team up with my friends.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想跟朋友們組隊。

vocab.sentence: We have to finish cleaning the classroom.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們必須打掃完教室。

vocab.sentence: The doctor asked me not to stay up.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 醫生要求我不要熬夜。

I enjoy sports, for example, swimming and running.

phrases.sentence: Jason worked day and night to finish the project.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Jason 日以繼夜地工作來完成這個專案計畫。

phrases.sentence: I like singing; on the other hand, my brother likes dancing.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我喜歡唱歌；另一方面，我哥哥喜歡跳舞。

phrases.sentence: Staying up late can lead to health problems.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 熬夜可能導致健康問題。

phrases.sentence: We have to finish making the video today.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們今天必須完成影片製作。

phrases.sentence: The student stayed up studying last night.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那位學生昨晚熬夜讀書。

grammar.sentence: The actress keeps practicing in front of the camera.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位女演員持續在鏡頭前練習。

grammar.sentence: He left the room without saying a word.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他一句話也沒說就離開房間了。

grammar.sentence: The waiter asked us to wait outside.

grammar.sentence: Remember to bring your camera to school tomorrow.

grammar.sentence: The writer hopes to finish the story soon.

grammar.sentence: I finished cleaning the drums before lunch.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我在午餐前清潔完那些鼓。

grammar.sentence: They decided not to buy the expensive guitar.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們決定不買那把昂貴的吉他。

grammar.sentence: The children stopped talking when the music started.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 音樂開始時，孩子們停止了交談。

grammar.sentence: It is fun for us to train together.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一起訓練對我們來說很有趣。

grammar.sentence: The secretary needs to make some phone calls.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位秘書需要打幾通電話。

grammar.sentence: My brother practices playing the drums every evening.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我哥哥每天晚上練習打鼓。

grammar.sentence: The singer thanked us for coming to the show.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位歌手感謝我們來看表演。

grammar.sentence: I forgot to send the message last night.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我昨晚忘記傳那則訊息了。

grammar.sentence: The famous actor would like to meet you.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位有名的男演員想見你。

grammar.sentence: We had fun making music in the park.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們在公園裡玩音樂玩得很開心。

grammar.sentence: Taking photos of the stars is difficult.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 拍攝星星很困難。

grammar.sentence: The teacher taught us to use the camera.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 老師教我們使用相機。

grammar.sentence: We stopped to buy water during our walk.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們散步途中停下來買水。

grammar.sentence: The writer is busy reading her new story.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位作家正忙著閱讀她的新故事。

grammar.sentence: I remember meeting the star at our school.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我記得在學校見過那位明星。

grammar.sentence: They are thinking about starting a music club.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們正在考慮成立音樂社。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位家庭主婦去年夏天學會了製作影片。

cloze_quiz.question: The man who took our order and brought our food is a ___ at this restaurant.
cloze_quiz.hint: took our order 和 brought our food 指餐廳服務工作；the man 表示男性，所以是 waiter。

cloze_quiz.question: The woman works as a ___ in a restaurant. She serves meals to the customers.
cloze_quiz.hint: serves meals to the customers 是餐廳服務工作，且主詞是女性，所以用 waitress。

cloze_quiz.question: My mother does not have a paid job. She takes care of our home and family as a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 沒有受薪工作並照顧家庭，是本課 housewife「家庭主婦」的字義情境。

cloze_quiz.question: The ___ puts letters into the mailboxes on our street every morning.
cloze_quiz.hint: puts letters into the mailboxes 表示投遞信件，是 mailman「郵差」的工作；也可稱 mail carrier。

cloze_quiz.question: A ___ caught the man who stole my bicycle and took him to the police station.
cloze_quiz.hint: 抓竊賊並帶到警察局，是 police officer「警察」的工作情境。

cloze_quiz.question: Mr. Lin runs a company. His ___ answers his calls and makes plans for his meetings.
cloze_quiz.hint: 替主管接電話和安排會議，是 secretary「秘書」的工作。

cloze_quiz.question: My uncle is a ___. He helps make cars in a large factory every day.
cloze_quiz.hint: 在大工廠裡製造汽車，是 factory worker「工廠工人」的工作。

cloze_quiz.question: The man playing the king in the movie is a famous ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 在電影中扮演國王是演員工作，the man 表示男性，因此是 actor。

cloze_quiz.question: The woman playing the queen in the movie won a prize for being the best ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 在電影中扮演王后並獲演技獎項的是女演員，英文為 actress。

cloze_quiz.question: The ___ interviewed the mayor and wrote the news story for the newspaper.
cloze_quiz.hint: interviewed 和 news story 指採訪、撰寫新聞的工作，因此是 reporter「記者」。

cloze_quiz.question: Her job is to perform songs on stage. She is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: perform songs on stage 表示在舞臺上演唱歌曲，是 singer「歌手」。

cloze_quiz.question: This ___ spends every morning creating stories for his next book.
cloze_quiz.hint: creating stories for his next book 指為自己的下一本書創作故事，是 writer「作家」。

cloze_quiz.question: I like listening to ___, especially songs played on the piano.
cloze_quiz.hint: songs played on the piano 是鋼琴歌曲，屬於 music「音樂」。

cloze_quiz.question: He plays a ___ by moving his fingers across its six strings.
cloze_quiz.hint: six strings「六條弦」是吉他的線索；guitar 是吉他。

cloze_quiz.question: The child hit the ___ with two sticks to make a steady beat.
cloze_quiz.hint: 用兩根鼓棒敲出節奏，描述的是 drum「鼓」。

cloze_quiz.question: No one can tell exactly what will happen in the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: will happen 指還沒發生的事，搭配 future「未來」。

cloze_quiz.question: The science book is full of fun facts. I find it ___ and never feel bored while reading it.
cloze_quiz.hint: full of fun facts 和 never feel bored 表示內容引人興趣，因此是 interesting「有趣的」。

cloze_quiz.question: Please use this ___ to take a picture of our whole class.
cloze_quiz.hint: take a picture 表示拍照，需要 camera「相機」。

cloze_quiz.question: It is ___ to follow the safety rules because they help keep us safe.
cloze_quiz.hint: 規則能保護安全，所以遵守規則是 important「重要的」。

cloze_quiz.question: Almost everyone at school loves this song. It is very ___ with the students.
cloze_quiz.hint: 幾乎每個學生都喜歡，表示 popular「受歡迎的」。

cloze_quiz.question: She has a natural ___ for music. She can play a song after hearing it only once.
cloze_quiz.hint: 只聽一次就能演奏，顯示有音樂天分；gift 在這裡是「天分」，不是禮物。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ me your name so I can write it on this card.
cloze_quiz.hint: tell＋人＋內容，表示告訴某人某事；這裡是請對方說出名字。say、talk、listen 不能直接接 me your name。

cloze_quiz.question: His story was full of silly jokes. It was so ___ that everyone laughed.
cloze_quiz.hint: silly jokes 和 everyone laughed 都是讓人發笑的線索，funny 表示好笑的。

cloze_quiz.question: Our ___ for Saturday is to visit the zoo in the morning and the museum in the afternoon.
cloze_quiz.hint: 句子列出星期六的行程安排，因此是 plan「計畫」。

cloze_quiz.question: A bright ___ shone in the night sky above our house.
cloze_quiz.hint: night sky 和 shone 指夜空中發光的星星；star 也可指明星。

cloze_quiz.question: I left home ___ my keys, so I could not open the door when I returned.
cloze_quiz.hint: 回家無法開門表示出門時沒有帶鑰匙，without 是「沒有」。

cloze_quiz.question: I was asleep when I had a strange ___ about flying over the sea.
cloze_quiz.hint: asleep 和 flying over the sea 是睡夢情境，dream 在這裡指夢。

cloze_quiz.question: A person who is fifteen years old is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: fifteen 是 15 歲，屬於 teenager「青少年」的年齡範圍。

cloze_quiz.question: The final game was ___. We cheered loudly as our team won in the last second.
cloze_quiz.hint: 最後一秒獲勝且大家大聲歡呼，表示比賽 exciting「令人興奮的」。

cloze_quiz.question: The angry boys raised their fists and were about to ___ when the teacher stopped them.
cloze_quiz.hint: raised their fists 和 the teacher stopped them 表示舉起拳頭、被老師阻止，fight 是「打架」。

cloze_quiz.question: Anna helped Sue, and Sue helped Anna. They helped ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 兩人互相幫助，one another 就是「彼此」。

cloze_quiz.question: I need some ___ to pay for this meal in cash.
cloze_quiz.hint: pay 和 in cash 都與付款有關，需要 money「錢」。

cloze_quiz.question: People all over the world know this movie star. He is ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 全世界很多人都知道，表示 famous「有名的」。

cloze_quiz.question: The runners ___ on the track every day to become faster before the big race.
cloze_quiz.hint: 為了比賽跑更快而每天在跑道練習，是 train「訓練」的意思。

cloze_quiz.question: ___, the school show was canceled because of the storm. Everyone was disappointed.
cloze_quiz.hint: 演出取消且大家失望，是令人遺憾的消息，因此用 Sadly。

cloze_quiz.question: The two small clubs will ___ each other to make one big team.
cloze_quiz.hint: make one big team 表示合成一支大隊伍，team up with 是「跟……組隊」。

cloze_quiz.question: The school rule says all students ___ wear uniforms. Everyone must follow this rule.
cloze_quiz.hint: school rule 和 must 都表示規定必須做，所以用 have to。

cloze_quiz.question: I often ___ late to watch movies and do not go to bed until two in the morning.
cloze_quiz.hint: 凌晨 2 點才睡，表示熬夜；stay up 是「熬夜」。
